Software Requirements SpecificationTracker Point 67-In Pre shipment export invoice screen, make default values in 'Location Name' based on factory selection-Ref ID-67-379437Document # 431936 Version 1.0
TOC \h \z \t "Heading 1,2,Heading 2,3,Heading 3,4,Title,1"
Section 1: Overview
Automatically populate the "Location Name" fields on the Pre-Shipment Export Invoice screen based on the selected Execution Company and Factory.
Business Requirement
Section 3. Solution
Expected Functionality
Functional Requirements
Section 5. Revision History
Section 1: OverviewPurposeAutomatically populate the "Location Name" fields on the Pre-Shipment Export Invoice screen based on the selected Execution Company and Factory.Business RequirementThe system should display as default
Location Name
values that belong to the selected Execution Company & Factory.ScopeThis requirement applies to a Pre-shipment Export Invoice where Execution Company and Factory are selected based on that Location Name get populated.Requirement:
When user selects an Execution Company and Factory, the system should:Pick up the Location Name automatically from the Factory master mapped location address which is defined in company division master.Populate them as default values in the respective fields.Dropdown values for Location Name should be restricted/filtered only to records that belong to the selected Execution Company & Factory in the Division Consignor Master.Section 2. Assumptions This change will not impact on existing functionalities.Section 3. SolutionExpected FunctionalityNote: The "PSN Default Location" field should be available in the Factory Master only when the Pre-Shipment Export Invoice feature is enabled.
Functional RequirementsWhen the user selects an Execution Company and Factory, the system should:Automatically retrieve the Location Name from the PSN Default Location mapped in the selected Factory. Populate the corresponding fields with these values by default.
Section 4. GlossarySection 5. Revision HistoryVersion
Lalit Rajwar
